newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico net reserves, assets rise.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico net reserves, assets rise.

text.p: Banco de Mexico said on Tuesday its international reserves as of July 11 were $22.156 billion, compared to $22.00 billion on July 4.
The central bank said that its net international assets as of the same date were $14.905 billion compared to $14.568 billion the week before.
The central bank said the increase of $337 million in net international assets during the period was due to:
--Net outflows due to operations with the federal government of $29 million.
--The purchase of $62 million from credit institutions, a product of the exercising of options on the sale of dollars to the central bank that were issued during the auction of June 30.
--Net income from operations by the state oil company Pemex worth $319 million.

--A net loss of $15 million for a combination of factors including changes in the dollar value of non-dollar assets and liabilities held by the bank; net returns on interest rates and from trading of metals and securities; and net deposits in dollar accounts from commercial banks at the central bank.
Banco de Mexico said that up to July 11, the balance in the foreign exchange fund, not included in international assets, to be used to prepay notes on August 6, was $4.886 billion.

Between July 4 and 11, the monetary base rose 2.183 billion pesos due to a lump payment to teachers of their July and August salaries. The bank said it had expected these payments to come in two tranches, at the end of June and beginning of July, which explained why the trajectory of the monetary base exceeded expectations announced by Banco de Mexico in January. It expected the effect would decline in coming weeks.
In the same period, the government's balance at the central bank fell 7.469 billion pesos, and deposits at the Bank Insurance Fund Fobaproa dropped by 2.222 billion pesos.
The bank said it undertook monetary regulation operations for a total of 9.186 billion pesos in the same time frame.
The following tables detail Banco de Mexico's reserves and net domestic credit. All figures are in billions of pesos, unless otherwise indicated.

International Reserves
